name: Hikari no Naka de Dakishimete
original_name: ひかりの中で抱きしめて
source:
Hero happens to be in a bullet train that's just been hijacked. He manages to disarm one of hijackers in the toilet takes his mask and weapon. But he's tempted by the situation as he can freely harass any passengers now... 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-may-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
英雄恰好在一列刚刚被劫持的子弹头列车上。他在厕所里成功解除了一名劫机者的武装，夺走了他的面具和武器。但他对这种情况很感兴趣，因为他现在可以随意骚扰任何乘客…… 

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-may-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
